name: Murder in Crayontopia
source:
Grab your crayons and delve into the world of Crayontopia in this murder mystery visual novel. Become an adept or inept detective as you gather evidence, get to know your fellow crayon-lovers, and seek to uncover the colorful secrets behind the murders that plague this seemingly perfect world.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3551750]Steam[/url]]
translation:
拿起你的蜡笔，在这部谋杀悬疑视觉小说中深入探索蜡笔托邦的世界。收集证据，结识蜡笔爱好者，并试图揭开困扰这个看似完美世界的谋杀案背后的多彩秘密，成为一名熟练或无能的侦探。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3551750]Steam[/url]]
